About Us

SK Machineries International

It's a One-Stop Shop for Power, Heavy Earth Moving Construction Equipment.

SK Machinery International

SK MACHINERY INTERNATIONAL is a One-Stop sales center for Power, Heavy Earth Moving Construction Equipment, Mining and Gas Generator Spare Parts. SK MACHINERY INTERNATIONAL is one of the Leading hydraulic Pump Parts Seller in Bangladesh for Japanese, USA, European & Chinese Excavators.

SK MACHINERY INTERNATIONAL is the Authorized distributor for ITR (Undercarriage parts for all brands of equipment from Italy), CTP (Replacement parts for Caterpillar equipment from USA), JIC (Hydraulic pump, rotary kit for CAT, Kobelco, Komatsu, Sumitomo, Hitachi, Mitsubishi brand excavator from South Korea) and Handok (Hydraulic pump, it's rotary kit for CAT, Kobelco, Komatsu, Sumitomo, Hitachi and Mitsubishi brand excavator from South Korea).

Authorized distributor

SK MACHINERY INTERNATIONAL is the authorized distributor for:

  • ITR — undercarriage parts for all brands of equipment, from Italy.
  • CTP — replacement parts for Caterpillar equipment, from the USA.
  • JIC — hydraulic pump, rotary kit for CAT, Kobelco, Komatsu, Sumitomo, Hitachi, Mitsubishi brand excavator, from South Korea.
  • HANDOK — hydraulic pump, it’s rotary kit for CAT, Kobelco, Komatsu, Sumitomo, Hitachi and Mitsubishi brand excavator, from South Korea.

Certificates of authorization are published on our Certification page.

What we keep in ready stock

  • All engine-side new replacement parts of the CTP brand for Caterpillar equipment.
  • More than 100 models of HANDOK brand hydraulic pump parts for Japanese excavators.

How we work with buyers

We assist buyers with urgent, long-term and project-based spare parts. Send your parts list, model numbers or catalogue references and our sales desk will confirm availability and quote your requirement.
